nodes.name: Nodal Analysis
nodes.description: Systematic method using KCL to find node voltages; applicable to all planar and non-planar circuits

nodes.name: Mesh Analysis
nodes.description: Systematic method using KVL to find mesh currents; restricted strictly to planar circuits

nodes.name: Supernode
nodes.description: Formed by enclosing a dependent or independent voltage source connected between two non-reference nodes; treated as a single node for KCL

nodes.name: Supermesh
nodes.description: Formed by removing a current source branch shared between two adjacent meshes and applying KVL around the perimeter loop

nodes.name: Kirchhoffs Current Law
nodes.description: The algebraic sum of currents entering any node equals zero; conservation of electrical charge

nodes.name: Kirchhoffs Voltage Law
nodes.description: The algebraic sum of voltages around any closed loop equals zero; conservation of energy

nodes.name: Thevenin Equivalent
nodes.description: Any linear two-terminal circuit replaced by an open-circuit voltage source Vth in series with resistance Rth

nodes.name: Norton Equivalent
nodes.description: Any linear two-terminal circuit replaced by a short-circuit current source In in parallel with resistance Rn where Rn = Rth

nodes.name: Source Transformation
nodes.description: Equivalence duality allowing conversion between Thevenin series voltage source and Norton parallel current source via Ohms Law
